steps.text: Hello, you've reached {{bank_name}}'s AI specialist. This call is recorded.
Hi Sarah, how can I help you today?
Hi. I think I've lost my debit card. I had it at the gym last night and now I can't find it anywhere.

steps.summary: Sarah has lost her debit card and is worried about it being used.

steps.text: Oh no, that's stressful. Let's get it sorted. I've just sent a notification to your banking app. Please tap Approve when you see it, and I'll wait on the line.
Thanks Sarah, that's confirmed. Thank you for that. I'll need to place you on hold for a moment while I check the system. I'll be right back with you.
Thanks for holding. I can see your debit card ending in four eight two one. I'll put a temporary lock on it right now.
Done. Your card's locked, so nobody can use it. It's only a temporary lock, and you can undo it in the app if the card turns up.
The last transaction was eight dollars fifty at Pulse Gym Cafe, yesterday at six forty-two pm. Does that sound like you?
Yes, that was me. A coffee after my class.

steps.summary: Card ending 4821 temporarily locked. Sarah confirmed the last transaction was hers.

steps.text: Perfect, so nothing unfamiliar. I've sent you a text to confirm the lock, and your reference is {{lock_card.case_number}}. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. That was so easy, thank you.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Take care.
